name: spook
iocPatterns: RDP brute-force attempts and unauthorized access
Encrypted files across network shares and endpoints
keyCapabilities: Double extortion tactics (data encryption and leak)
recommendedActions: Strengthen RDP security protocols and consider disabling if unused.
Enhance phishing awareness training for employees.
Deploy network monitoring tools to detect C2 communications.
Implement robust backup strategies to mitigate ransomware impact.
campaignsText: Spook's campaigns were active around two weeks in late 2021, targeting mainly the manufacturing sector with 35 recorded victims. Notable for publishing victim names post-attack, regardless of ransom payment.
description: The threat actor known as 'spook' operates as a rebranded version of the Prometheus ransomware group, focusing on double-extortion attacks. Active between October 4-19, 2021, they targeted primarily the manufacturing sector globally and uniquely published victim names regardless of payment.
goals: Spook's strategic goals are primarily financial gain through ransomware operations. Their focus on double extortion and data leak threats aligns with maximizing monetary gains. The concentration on manufacturing suggests targets with significant data or operational disruption potential.
